name: Gitea · Recent repositories
description: Recently updated repositories from a Gitea API.
template:
<Stack data-gp="gitea" gap={4} p={6} style={{ width: "100%", boxSizing: "border-box", minHeight: 0, fontFamily: "inherit" }}>
<Group justify="space-between" wrap="nowrap"><Group gap={7}><TablerIcon name="git-branch" size={18}/><Title order={3} size="h4">Recent repos</Title></Group><Group gap={6}><Anchor href="https://app.example.net/explore/repos?sort=recentupdate" target="_blank" size="xs">Gitea ↗</Anchor><RefreshButton requestId="repos" size="xs"/></Group></Group>
<Accordion variant="default" keepMounted defaultValue={null}><Accordion.Item value="filter" style={{ border: 0 }}><Accordion.Control p={0} styles={{ label: { padding: "calc(4px * var(--mantine-scale, 1)) 0", fontFamily: "inherit", fontSize: "calc(13px * var(--mantine-scale, 1))" } }}>Filter repositories{inputs.search ? " · active" : ""}</Accordion.Control><Accordion.Panel styles={{content:{padding:"calc(4px * var(--mantine-scale, 1)) 0"}}}><TextInput bind="search" defaultValue="" aria-label="Filter repositories" placeholder="Repository or owner…" size="xs"/></Accordion.Panel></Accordion.Item></Accordion>
{status.repos?.ok === false ? <Alert color="red" title="Git service unavailable">Could not load recent repositories.</Alert> : !data.repos ? <Text size="xs" lh={1.2} c="dimmed">Loading repositories…</Text> : (data.repos?.data ?? []).filter(r => (r.full_name ?? "").toLowerCase().includes((inputs.search ?? "").toLowerCase())).length === 0 ? <Text size="xs" lh={1.2} c="dimmed">No matching repositories.</Text> : <Stack gap={4}>
<SimpleGrid cols={2} spacing={6}>{(data.repos?.data ?? []).filter(r => (r.full_name ?? "").toLowerCase().includes((inputs.search ?? "").toLowerCase())).slice((Number(inputs.page ?? 1)-1)*6,Number(inputs.page ?? 1)*6).map(r => <Paper key={r.id} p={6} withBorder radius="md" style={{background:"var(--gp-panel, #111c2b)",borderColor:"var(--gp-line, #243247)",minWidth:0}}><Anchor href={r.html_url} target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" title={r.full_name} style={{textDecoration:"none",color:"inherit"}}><Text size="xs" lh={1.2} fw={600} truncate>{r.name}</Text><Group justify="space-between" gap={3} wrap="nowrap"><Text size="xs" lh={1.2} c="dimmed" truncate>{(r.updated_at ?? "").slice(0,10)}</Text><Text size="xs" lh={1.2} c="teal" truncate>{r.language ?? ""}</Text></Group></Anchor></Paper>)}</SimpleGrid>
<Group justify="space-between" gap={4}><Text size="xs" lh={1.2} c="dimmed">Repository updates</Text><Pagination bind="page" defaultValue={1} resetKey={inputs.search ?? ""} total={Math.max(1,Math.ceil((data.repos?.data ?? []).filter(r => (r.full_name ?? "").toLowerCase().includes((inputs.search ?? "").toLowerCase())).length/6))} size="xs" siblings={0}/></Group></Stack>}
</Stack>
